key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the helper is asked for fresh usage. The macOS app defaults to two minutes.

key.name: helper-path
key.description: Leave empty to find the helper on PATH.

key.name: pinned-account
key.description: macOS stores isPinned inside the account record; the helper's six-field decrypt projection carries no such flag, so the extension keeps the pin here. Empty means nothing is pinned. Pinning is exclusive: one id at a time, matching sortStates()'s "unpin all, then pin target".

key.name: run-commands
key.summary: Saved run command per account, as a JSON object
key.description: macOS keys these by Account.id in UserDefaults (RunCommandSettings). The helper's accounts carry no UUID, so this maps the same derived account id used everywhere else to its saved command.

key.name: run-command-terminals
key.summary: Per-account "open in terminal" preference, as a JSON object
key.description: Only accounts the user explicitly switched on appear; everything else falls back to the classifier's verdict.

key.name: auto-refresh-enabled
key.summary: Whether the panel refreshes on a timer
key.description: SettingsView.swift's Toggle("Enable auto refresh"). With this off the panel only refreshes when asked. The interval itself is refresh-interval.

key.name: auto-update-check
key.summary: Check GitHub for a newer release once a day
key.description: SettingsView.swift's "Auto-update daily". The macOS app installs what it finds; this one only reports it, because a Shell extension cannot replace the helper binary or itself under a running session.

key.name: last-update-check
key.summary: Unix seconds of the last update check
key.description: Zero means never. Written whatever the outcome, so a failing check does not retry every hour.
